entry_points.text: Deferred destroy releases unregistered superblock; misc and script init and exit install and remove formats and fs type at head, draining callbacks before text free.
Fs helpers publish as module-owned set with filter for monitors and conditionally misc ops; successful program removal emits attribute notification.
Device completions unwrap buffer, propagate quiet marking, release request and dispatch to sync or async finalization.

exports.text: Teardown discards caches, quiesces writeback and error bias, runs teardown hooks, publishes dying, releases protection and returns anon devno.
Registry matches names exactly, rejects bad names and duplicates, invalidates cache on change; removal waits for readers; context log records warnings and errors.
Unmount reclaim detaches primary then secondary roots until empty, evicts only unreferenced stable inodes marked freeing, releasing outside global locks with rescheduling.
Sync skips readonly and neutral backing; otherwise writes inodes, runs fs hooks, syncs device, waits preexisting inodes and drains cgroups, first error wins.
Background writeback sizes work from dirty counters, skips clean domains, coalesces starts, wakes flushers and sleeps until completions finish with overlong diagnostic.
Virtual xattr rejects ACL names, resolves handler and delegates; empty stays present, removal uses absent value; kernfs serves from cache with size negotiation.
BPF helpers acquire and release exe files, render paths, get and set xattrs, read user-ns cgroup and socket xattrs, and resolve stacked data inodes.
Buffer layer completes sync and async IO into validity, records errors, unlocks, completes folio on last sibling and syncs metadata queues.

hazards.text: Incomplete eviction is corruption with linkages poisoned to force clean failure; teardown must return anon devnos and reset backing to neutral sink.
Sync failures propagate immediately without later phases, preserving error visibility over progress.
Untrusted inputs are racy; setters duplicate before validation with limits, scripts never execute truncated tokens and tolerate missing newline only when proven complete.
Removal omits post hook to avoid deadlock; sibling finish needs lock; writes stick on mapping and owner; losers observe winner and migration folios rejected.

invariants.text: Fresh superblock starts biased refs, neutral backing, isolated flags, defaults, empty lists with locks, per-level freeze, held protection and reclaim state.
Background is nonblocking tagged budgeted, full sync is blocking all-range with marker under switch guard in one build; budget splits or passthrough; waiter drops initial ref.
Param tables fail on conflicting duplicates, flags lack types; invalidation bumps generation in one build and inert in other, as are notify and keyring teardown.
Misc fs has fixed name, allows userns mounts, installs dedicated free and tree handlers via context init; each binfmt links module and loader.
BPF misc offers sleepable selection helpers for struct-ops only, requires match and load, validates names, paths and flag combinations.
BPF reads allow user and security BPF, writes security BPF only, each after permission check; names use longest prefix, corrupt is IO error, unmatched unsupported.
Dirty checks need folio lock, buffers live in folio private; verity runs only when active in one build; new kernfs attrs start empty root-owned via cmpxchg.

locks.text: Acquisition refuses when protection already held, succeeds only for born nondying with shared or exclusive protection, holding passive ref across list lock and waiting on dying.
Reclaim and sync need exclusive protection, serialize root hash, dentries under RCU and inode walks with rescheduling; wait adds sync mutex and writeback lock.
Writeback wakeup uses IRQ-safe work lock promoting idle domains; registry and BPF ops mutate under spinlocks; fanout iterates under RCU with liveness pinning and stack fallback.
Buffers use lock bit with uninterruptible wait and wakeup; async siblings elect single completer under first-buffer lock; assoc queue needs owner lock with RCU pin and revalidation.
Program dentry mutation holds inode lock throughout; root lookup and error recording run under RCU without blocking.

state_machines.text: Visibility moves born active to dying broadcast with release, then dead where acquisitions fail and holders wake; finders observe until terminal, others discard once dying.
Inodes evict only when refs read zero twice without freeing or new flags, then marked freeing and released; per-domain starts coalesce via test-and-set until consumed.
BPF ops move unregistered to registered with userns and link after uniqueness check until matching pair removed; type published at boot; helper access filters by program type.
Scripts require magic, prove completeness, trim blanks and rebuild stack; slow lookup rejects migration; metadata sync drains then waits.
Buffers unlock with validity by status, last async sibling completes folio; verity defers to workqueue, allocation failure completes invalid immediately.

structs.text: Superblock carries protection, links, lists with locks, serialization, ops, bounds, reclaim, helpers and counters with stated time, batch, freeze and flag defaults.
Work descriptors carry target, mode, budget, tagging, reason and completion linkage; completions carry refcount, waitqueue, timing and progress.
BPF entries link node, ops and userns; verify carries work and context; kernfs attrs hold list, ownership, times and counters; buffers link one owner queue.
Stable encodings cover removal, POSIX rejection, missing data, short dest, bad inode, namespace denial, IO failure, misc name, absolute path, name max and five exec flags.
